user.title: Connect to Switchboard
user.description: Enter your Switchboard host and the External API token (Switchboard → Settings → External API).

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for Switchboard's self-signed certificate unless you front it with a trusted certificate.
data_description.fingerprint: Optional. Pin the self-signed certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (shown on the Peers tab) — recommended over disabling verification.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Switchboard
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {host} was rejected. Generate a new token in Switchboard → Settings → External API and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Switchboard
reconfigure.description: Change the connection settings for this Switchboard instance.

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for Switchboard's self-signed certificate unless you front it with a trusted certificate.
data_description.fingerprint: Optional. Pin the self-signed certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (shown on the Peers tab) — recommended over disabling verification.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host, port, and that the External API is enabled.
error.access_denied: The token works, but this device is denied by the Events/Control ACLs — allow your Home Assistant IP in Switchboard → Settings → External API.
error.bad_fingerprint: The TLS fingerprint is not valid hex.
error.no_tls_trust: Set the TLS fingerprint, or turn on certificate verification. Switchboard uses a self-signed certificate, so with neither of these the connection cannot be authenticated and anyone on your network could read the API token as it is sent. The fingerprint is on Switchboard's Peers tab.

abort.already_configured: This Switchboard instance is already configured.

run_action.name: Run action
run_action.description: Run any Switchboard rule action through /api/command.

action_type.name: Action type
action_type.description: The action to run, e.g. obs_scene_set, obs_delay_set, twitch_category_set, spotify_playback_start.

target.name: Target
target.description: Connection label or id (or a sentinel like "spotify"). Leave blank for actions with no target.

value.name: Value
value.description: The action value, e.g. a scene name or delay in seconds.

action_params.name: Action params
action_params.description: Optional extra action parameters as a JSON object, e.g. remember set to true.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

obs_scene_set.name: Set OBS scene
obs_scene_set.description: Switch the program scene of an OBS connection.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Name of the scene to switch to.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

go_live.name: Go live
go_live.description: Fetch a Twitch account's stream key, set it on the target OBS and start its stream as one operation, then make that account Switchboard's default. Needs the twitch_control scope — a 403 means the token lacks it (grant the scope to the paired plugin, or use the global External API token).

account_id.name: Twitch account
account_id.description: Twitch connection label or id — an account on the Switchboard machine running the command (it owns the stream key).

obs_id.name: OBS connection
obs_id.description: OBS connection label or id the stream key is delivered to. Leave blank for Switchboard's default OBS connection.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

overlay_alert.name: Show overlay alert
overlay_alert.description: Show an alert on the Switchboard alerts overlay.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

set_variable.name: Set a variable
set_variable.description: Set one of Switchboard's user variables (a counter, a mode flag, a label). Creates it if it doesn't exist yet, and fires Switchboard's variable_changed automations.

variable.name: Variable
variable.description: The variable name, e.g. deaths. Lowercased by Switchboard; letters, digits and underscores only.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

add_to_variable.name: Add to a variable
add_to_variable.description: Add a number to one of Switchboard's user variables (negative to subtract). A variable that doesn't exist yet starts at 0.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much to add. Negative subtracts. Defaults to 1.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

set_machine_state.name: Set machine state (AFK)
set_machine_state.description: Set the Switchboard machine's explicit state, firing its machine_state_afk / machine_state_active automations.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

light_flash.name: Flash a light
light_flash.description: Blink a light or light group N times in a colour through Switchboard's downstream Home Assistant connection, then restore its previous state. Requires the global External API token.

entity_id.name: Light entity
entity_id.description: The light or light group to flash, e.g. light.studio_key.

target.name: Home Assistant connection
target.description: Switchboard's Home Assistant connection label or id. Leave blank to use its default connection.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Flash brightness on Home Assistant's 1-255 scale. Default 255.

color_temp_kelvin.name: Colour temperature
color_temp_kelvin.description: Flash in a white colour temperature (2000-6500 K) instead of the colour.

on_ms.name: On time
on_ms.description: How long the light holds the flash colour per cycle, in milliseconds (100-5000). Default 500.

off_ms.name: Off time
off_ms.description: Gap between cycles with the light off, in milliseconds (100-5000). Default 500.

transition_ms.name: Transition
transition_ms.description: Transition passed to Home Assistant on every step, in milliseconds (0-5000). Default 150.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

afk_snooze.name: Snooze AFK
afk_snooze.description: Hold off the idle-to-AFK automation for a while (mid-cutscene guard). Repeated calls stack, capped at 4 hours; 0 cancels an active snooze.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to snooze for. 0 cancels.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.

afk_reset_idle.name: Reset idle clock
afk_reset_idle.description: Reset Switchboard's idle clock without synthesizing input, postponing an idle-to-AFK rule. If the machine is already AFK, input can flip it back to active.

entry_id.name: Switchboard instance
entry_id.description: Which Switchboard config entry to send this to. Leave blank when only one is set up.
